firstSteps.title: Getting started
firstSteps.howItWorks: The whole journey, step by step, in “How it works”

profile.title: Create your profile from your CV
profile.body: Upload your CV (PDF or Word) and press “Create my profile from my CV”: your agent reads it, asks you what the CV doesn't say and saves nothing without your OK.
profile.done: Profile created: review it in “My profile”
profile.byHand: No CV or no agent? Start by hand in “My profile”

search.title: Choose where to search
search.body: Your agent asks which job boards you use, recommends others and prepares the searches with the roles in your profile.
search.manual: or add a job board yourself
search.done: Job boards set up: see them in “Where to search”

firstSteps.whatItDoes: CandidatAI keeps your job search in order: it stores the jobs you're interested in, tells you which ones fit you and prepares a CV for each one.
firstSteps.whatIsTheAgent: The part that needs AI (reading the jobs, assessing them, writing your CVs) is done by your agent: the AI program you have installed on your computer, like Claude Code or Codex. The app alone doesn't read jobs or write CVs. <agent>What it is and how to install it, in “Agent”</agent>.
